Clinical Treatment Summary
The patient was treated for a neck strain after being struck from behind while turning left in a vehicle. The patient described the
contact as minor. Care consisted of conservative management, including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise
program, and the patient attended 29 visits over the course of treatment. The episode ran longer than is typical for a cervical strain
of this kind. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a soft tissue injury to the cervical region, with restricted range of
motion and muscle guarding noted on exam. The severity of the symptoms reported is greater than the mechanism of injury in the
history would typically suggest, although the objective fidnings are consistent. No prior injury to the neck or upper back is known
to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services. The patient is currently
improving with the home program and will be re-evaluated as needed.
</page>
